records.name: guide
records.label: guide
records.screen: FIRST RUN What this copy needs ToolsEnabled works on one computer on its own. Some of its screens read reports that a group of computers writes, and on a fresh install nothing has written one yet. Here is what is missing, what you can do about it, and what is already working. Running an agent on this computer YOU CAN DO THIS NOW ToolsEnabled does not contain the program that runs an agent. Codex does, and it is a separate install. Once it is on this computer and signed in, the agent page can start a session and every run is written down on this computer before it begins. winget install OpenAI.Codex in Windows Terminal. If you already have Node, "npm install -g @openai/codex" does the same thing. codex login in the same window, once the install finishes. Turn on "Run an agent session" in Settings, under Write. Every action that writes anything ships switched off. Open Settings Why the fleet graph, comms board, metrics and ledger are empty NOTHING TO TURN ON Those screens read a report written by an agent host, and this copy of ToolsEnabled does not include one. There is no setting that connects one and no command that installs one, so nothing you do will fill those screens today. They say so rather than showing numbers that are not yours. This is the honest state of the product, not a fault on your computer. If you saw this on another screen, this is what it meant: No local agent fleet host detected on this machine. To see what one of those screens looks like with data in it, turn its live source off in Settings, under Data and Sim. Each screen then shows a worked example, labelled as an example. Open Settings Sending a message to a coordinator YOU CAN DO THIS NOW The box on the first page has no place to type because sending replies is switched off, and because there is no coordinator on this computer to send one to. Turning the switch on is worth doing so the box is ready, and it will stay quiet until an agent host reports here. Turn on "Coordinator replies" in Settings, under Write. Open Settings What already works here NO SETUP Every agent run started from this window is written down on this computer, signed, and listed on the first page. The fleet graph draws the organisation this copy declares, and each agent on it opens a page of its own. The permission level you chose during setup is what a session is built from, and it can be changed in Settings. All settings Back to the first page

Some of its screens read reports that a group of computers writes, and on a fresh install nothing has written one yet. Here is what is missing, what you can do about it, and what is already working. Running an agent on this computer YOU CAN DO THIS NOW ToolsEnabled does not contain the program that runs an agent. Codex does, and it is a separate install. Once it is on this computer and signed in, the agent page can start a session and every run is written down on this computer before it begins. winget install OpenAI.Codex in Windows Terminal.
